setup_vasp_calc_mof: create a VASP calculator for MOF relaxation and write input files to a directory
setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: create a VASP calculator for MOF plus adsorbate relaxation and write input files
run_setup_vasp_calc_mof: run the setup_vasp_calc_mof function to generate VASP input files for a MOF structure
run_setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: run the setup_vasp_mof_and_ads function to generate VASP input files for a MOF with adsorbates
review_vasp_parameters: review the VASP calculator parameters used in setup_vasp_calc_mof for MOF relaxation settings
